title: Two Squares at Once
setup: Your king is nowhere near, and Black's king on g5 is setting off after your a-pawn. Find the only way the pawn reaches the eighth rank.
hint: Picture a box from your pawn up to its queening square and across. The black king must not be able to step inside it.
explanation:
## The Idea

{{a4}} leaves the pawn four moves from a8. Draw the box from a4 up to a8 and across to the e-file: the king on g5 cannot step into it, so it never catches the pawn.

A one-square step to a3 leaves five moves to go, the box stretches to the f-file, and the king steps inside at once. The pawn's double first step is the whole difference.
